written: 2026-10-30, from 2025 and simulated data only; pushed before any 2026 blend result is computed
definition: blend = m + w (q - m); m = T-90 Kalshi market (probability for winners, ladder mean for margin and total); q = model; code in reports/roadmap/i4_blend.py with K_PRIOR_GAMES = 50 (Amendment P2-2)
weight: w for each game uses only completed earlier weeks of the 2026 sample: w = clip(sum(x u) / (sum(x^2) + K), 0, 1), x = q - m, u = outcome minus m, K = 50 x mean(x^2) over the games of the first 3 weeks of 2026; w = 0 in the first week
statistic: paired loss difference blend minus market (log loss for winners, normal CRPS with the ladder spread for margin and total), cluster-robust t interval, week is the cluster
claim_tested: non-inferiority: the 90% interval for blend minus market lies below +0.005 log loss (winners) or +1% of the market's mean CRPS (margin, total). Equivalence status is also reported. No claim of beating the market is made.
looks: same schedule and validity rule as confirmatory_rules.json: first valid look after 10 completed 2026 weeks; spending alpha*(t) = 2(1 - Phi(1.96/sqrt(t))), t = weeks/18
descriptive: blend minus raw model, final weight per target, share of weeks with w above 0.1
